sections.who: Published rules assess income, responsibility for energy costs, an adult or emancipated household member and at least one citizen or qualifying noncitizen.
sections.get: Home-energy assistance under the approved household assessment and available funding.

sections.apply:
1. Find current intake

    Use the HEAT application links.

  2. Check local requirements

    Ask your local HEAT office which application window applies.

  3. Provide records

    Submit the bill and household-income checklist.
sections.after: Raise disconnection concerns with the local office and ask about a weatherization referral.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using HEAT eligibility and checklist. USA Assistance background guide. The linked provider must confirm current eligibility and intake arrangements.

faqs: Must the household pay home-energy costs?
Yes. Published HEAT rules include responsibility for energy costs.
The state recommends asking about a referral when applying for HEAT.
Application timing and available funds can affect intake.
